verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Airbyte issues API access tokens for programmatic use (airbyte-docs-17), and the pricing page lists RBAC (airbyte-docs-29), which hints that permissions can be role-based. Nothing ties these together into credentials scoped to an agent. Missing for 10: documented per-token scopes or least-privilege permission sets, RBAC applied to API credentials or service accounts, agent-specific credential issuance, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
